_doc: Registry of cove services. Each service owns ONE colour, as a pair: 'signal' (bright fill for blocks, badges, primary buttons; ink text on top) and 'text' (deeper shade for links/text on light backgrounds). All pairs pass WCAG AA. Set <html data-service="<key>"> and cove.css does the rest. Add new services here AND in cove.css ([data-service] + .svc-dot).
